widgets_values:
Two malformed, warty goblins giggling in a grimy alley, their devilish cackles more squeaky than sinister. The first is a scrawny, hunched creature with one bulging eye and a nose with a mole on it and snot dripping from it's tip, his claws are broken fingernails wearing top hat with MASTERCARD logo consisitng of overlapping red and orange circles with white text "MASTERCARD" over them glued to front side of top hat. The second is a pot-bellied with logo "VISA" on his stomach, toothless runt with patchy mold-green hair, his goofy roar sounding like a hiccup holding cracked long ladle.
between them a small pedestal with blue hexagon with white letter "C" on it lying on pedestal.
they surrounded by piles of trash. Oily puddles reflect their delusions of grandeur.
on top of image floating text "Soon they will have no Buzz!" adorned with green sickly miasma and unidentified liquid dripping from letters same as at the bottom text "khe-khe-khe..."
